name: Being Insecure
overview: Scripture reveals that true security comes from a renewed heart and spirit given by God, as Psalm 51:10 requests a clean heart and a constant spirit within. Our insecurity is often rooted in failing to recognize God's sovereign creation of all things (John 1:3) and the freedom found in knowing His truth (John 8:32). Jesus promises the Holy Spirit as a Comforter and teacher (John 14:26), who guides believers into all truth, helping them overcome doubt and insecurity. Furthermore, the call to refrain from judgment (Matthew 7:1) reminds us to trust God's righteous standards rather than our own uncertain assessments.
